messages:
anya: Heads-up: small thread to decide safepoint + projection strategy for the console analytics migration. Need minimal index churn and a fast rollback path.
rohan: What's the safepoint plan?
anya: Before we enable wide dual-write, snapshot the routing join keys and a tiny routing config blob. That lets reconcilers resume from a known state.
mike: Agreed. Suggested safepoint command: `pg_dump --table=routing_keys --data-only --file=safepoint_routing_$(date +%s).sql` and also `psql -c "COPY (SELECT route_id, hashtext(route_id) AS route_hash FROM routing_keys) TO STDOUT" > safepoint_hashes.csv`.
jess: UI-wise we need a "reading experimental data" flag in the console and a per-tenant quota-delta card. Keep it behind a ff.
tom: Index strategy: use a partial btree on (route_id, day) + BRIN on event_time to reduce bloat. Example DDL: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_proj_route_day ON ingest_projection(route_id, day) WHERE day >= current_date - INTERVAL '14 days';`
rohan: Canary gating: start at 2% for 6h -> 10% for 24h -> 25% for 48h. Abort if tenant_delta_pct > 0.5% for tenants >5k tokens/day or if console p95 rises >20%.
mike: (typo) 1
mike: Reconciliation query for runbook (compact):
```
SELECT route_id,
  sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then tokens else 0 end) v1_tokens,
  sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then tokens else 0 end) v2_tokens,
  100.0*(v2_tokens - v1_tokens)/GREATEST(1,v1_tokens) AS delta_pct
FROM ingestion_events
WHERE day >= current_date - INTERVAL '2 days'
GROUP BY route_id
HAVING GREATEST(sum(case when ingest_version='v1' then tokens else 0 end), sum(case when ingest_version='v2' then tokens else 0 end)) > 1000;
```
eva: (not present)
jess: Add a rollout-bot hook to auto-pause if p95_ratio > 1.2. `rollout-bot` should POST a pause event to the admin API.
rollout-bot: automated: will run health checks every 5m during canary and pause on thresholds :gear: 
ingest-bot: automated: shadow-write cron ready for 2024-06-12T01:00Z when flags enabled
rohan: Also include a small audit dump for random 100 routes/day with full JSON diffs for manual inspection.
anya: I'll author the runbook with the exact DDL/psql/curl commands and assign owners: Mike (projection DDL + index), Jess (console UI + dashboard), Tom (index safety), Rohan (canary controller), me (runbook + support notif).
jess: I'll add support escalation step for 25% canary.
anya: Thanks — opening PR now. If no objections we'll schedule the initial 2% canary next Wednesday AM.
